root_cause.text: The `rt_mt6_check()` function lacked validation of the `addrnr` field, allowing a netfilter rule with an `addrnr` value exceeding the `IP6T_RT_HOPS` limit to be installed, which later causes an out-of-bounds array access in `rt_mt6()` when it indexes into `rtinfo->addrs[]`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `if (rtinfo->addrnr > IP6T_RT_HOPS)` in `rt_mt6_check()` to reject such oversized values, preventing the malformed rule from being used in the match logic.

intent_record.intent_summary: Added a validation check to ensure the number of addresses in the routing header match does not exceed the maximum allowed, preventing potential out-of-bounds errors.
intent_record.what: Added a check in rt_mt6_check() to return -EINVAL if rtinfo->addrnr exceeds IP6T_RT_HOPS.
intent_record.how: Prevents installation of a routing header match rule when the number of addresses specified (addrnr) is greater than the maximum allowed (IP6T_RT_HOPS), avoiding potential out-of-bounds access or invalid state.
